limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter’s handshake condition but also removed the downstream-ready guard, changing how the first accepted value updates the accumulator when `ready_b` is low.

The scoreboard assumed each group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so the passing backpressure test reinforced the extra change instead of catching the regression against the reference behavior.
The knowledge-base search surfaced analogous handshake code for a serial-to-parallel converter, but it did not clarify the accumulator’s `ready_b` guard or visibly inform the fix.
